title: Compact-mode gesture resilience and chart hit-testing bug hunt
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Summary: Several regressions were reported in compact UI mode impacting gesture resilience (momentum scroll, sticky headers) and interactive hit-testing on charts and virtualized tables in Mobile Safari and Firefox desktop mobile-emulation. Symptoms include clipped hit areas for buttons in dense token rows, taps mis-targeting chart markers when dense axis labels are present, and table row hover/click offsets when the OS keyboard appears on iOS.
reproduction_steps: 1) Open the Redwood Console in mobile Safari (iPhone 12/13/14 simulator or physical device) and switch to 'Compact' density in the UI kit playground.
2) Navigate to a dashboard with an embedded virtualized table (1000+ rows) and a small line chart above it.
3) Trigger a fast fling scroll on the table and observe sticky header flicker or header detachment when momentum stops.
4) Tap a small action icon inside a dense token row immediately after the keyboard opens (search input focused) and observe misaligned hit area or missed taps.
5) On Firefox desktop with mobile viewport, hover/click on dense chart markers near the right edge and note clicks registering on the underlying container instead of the marker.
6) Repeat in Chrome and Safari desktop to confirm browser-specific differences.
initial_triage_findings: Issue is reproducible on iOS Safari 16.5+ and Firefox 112+ mobile emulation; Chrome desktop and Safari desktop show fewer failures.

Root cause appears to be a combination of (a) CSS transform-based virtualization causing subpixel layout shifts, (b) aggressive token density clamping reducing hit targets below 44px, and (c) our chart hit-testing layer not accounting for CSS transforms/scroll offsets in Firefox's pointer event model.
Keyboard open on iOS changes viewport height and triggers a reflow that our sticky header update path sometimes misses, especially when continuous scrolling (momentum) is active.
Accessibility risk: some actionable elements fall below recommended hit area size in compact mode; this could block keyboard/touch users.
Customer impact: medium — primarily power users on small devices; observed in internal support tickets 2837 and 2891.
proposed_actions: Design: raise minimum hit target to 40px for critical action buttons in compact tokens (tradeoff: denser visual rhythm) — design to provide token variants.
Engineering: modify virtualization layer to use translateY on a wrapper without fractional subpixel transforms and ensure pointer-events map correctly (ENG-4312 to implement).
Engineering: adjust chart hit-testing to compute hit areas from boundingClientRect + cumulative transforms; add Firefox-specific pointer correction (ENG-4389).
Create regression test harness with automated visual diffs for compact density across Safari/Firefox mobile emulation and a manual QA checklist for keyboard-open scenarios.
Follow-up accessibility audit once changes land to ensure 44px recommendation adherence where possible.
Schedule canary on console-staging with a limited rollout and a rollback plan.
design_decisions: Prefer increasing tappable area over reducing content density for critical actions; token label truncation acceptable in compact variant.
Introduce a compact-token 'action-zone' spacer that preserves visual density while expanding hit area via negative margin on the parent clickable region.
For sticky headers, implement a 'momentum guard' that defers reattachment logic until scroll velocity is below a threshold to avoid visual jumps.
engineering_notes: ENG feedback 2026-03-02 (from Priya R.): virtualization translateY was rounding to fractional px due to CSS calc; switching to transform: translate3d(Math.round(y),0,0) reduced jitter on Chrome but revealed pointer offset in Firefox.
Prototyped chart hit-testing fix: compute inverse matrix of applied transforms and map pointer coordinates — initial patch in PR #8421 shows improvement on Firefox but needs performance check.

Sticky header reattach race happens when keyboard triggers viewport resize event mid-animation; proposed fix is to listen for visualViewport API and suspend reattach until visualViewport.height stabilizes.
Estimated ENG work: ENG-4312 (virtualization + pointer mapping) 3 pts; ENG-4389 (chart hit-testing) 2 pts; cross-browser QA and fixes 2 pts.
qa_checklist: Verify compact mode token action zone taps on iPhone 11/12/13, iOS 15/16/17 Safari physical devices.
Confirm no regressions in default and cozy densities for all affected components.
Run automated visual diffs in BrowserStack for Safari/Firefox mobile emulation templates.
Validate chart marker clicks on Firefox desktop mobile-emulation and on Android Chrome.
Confirm sticky header stability while performing fast flings with keyboard open/closed on iOS.
Accessibility: use VoiceOver and touch target audit to ensure interactive controls are reachable.
